## Squachy got a glow-up (and I fixed a thing I probably should've caught sooner)

ALL CLEAR now cycles through the full rainbow instead of a shy green-to-cyan pulse, because beige was never really his color. He's also bigger now, and stands proudly on top of his own catchphrase like the oversized mascot he was always destined to be. Look at him. Look at that guy.

Also: rotating the screen used to just... freeze the whole device. Solid. Forever. You'd have to yank the power like it owed you money. Turns out that's been broken since before this thing even had a version number — nobody noticed because, in fairness, how often do you really rotate your surveillance detector. It's fixed now. You're welcome. Sorry it took this long, I was busy giving Squachy a bigger font.

### The actually-useful part
- "ALL CLEAR" / "DETECTIONS LOGGED" now render in the same comic-impact font as "!! DETECTION !!" on the alert screen
- ALL CLEAR cycles a full rainbow instead of the old two-color pulse
- Squachy is bigger and stands on top of the status text instead of hovering awkwardly above it
- **Fixed:** rotating the screen could freeze the device solid — heap fragmentation was silently killing the frame buffer's reallocation, no crash log, nothing, just a dead screen and a very healthy CPU underneath doing absolutely nothing useful. Diagnosed it, fixed it, and it now degrades gracefully instead of dying if it ever happens again.
- Freed a chunk of memory by telling the Bluetooth stack it doesn't need to keep the lights on for connections it was never going to make (it only ever scans — turns out reserving room for three simultaneous BLE handshakes you'll never do adds up)
